commit_gate: Publish this exact plan before metadata acquisition. Preserve its bytes and every failed/partial attempt; outcome is a separate record.
exposure_timing: Declared after the already recorded literature/abstract/search exposure, before these new capacity summaries or a study cohort. This is not a blinded source-selection design and does not certify an unseen holdout.
order: First the previously described20 AIDs, then every remaining AID ascending in batches of50; exactly37 batches.

precision_planning.assumptions: Independent Bernoulli groups/decision units; not guaranteed by identifiers, chemical uniqueness or repeated hypotheses. Not power for an AUC difference, series robustness or prediction. Missing/failing inputs can reduce attained precision and are not replaced.
precision_planning.binary_decision_rate: Prespecified screen hit fraction separately in each measured class

scope: New dated metadata-only capacity census of the already retrieved BRD4 gene-index universe; no dedicated activity/compound/coordinate endpoint or model/score. Target/source/cohort remain unaccepted.
source_rules: Every source count must be a typed nonnegative integer and each reply must contain exactly the requested distinct AIDs. Missing/conflicting/retired/failed evidence remains unknown, never zero.
All1780 counts must resolve before any census ranking or promotion; a partial prefix is not a complete census.

A source with fewer than100 tested SIDs cannot supply50 groups in each class when one eligible source occurrence supplies at most one group. Mixtures/aliases/repeated measurements are not split to manufacture groups.

A sufficient raw total is only a necessary capacity condition; no accepted experiment, label capacity, chemical/series independence, original-method availability or unseen holdout follows. Existing endpoint exclusions remain.
No pooling of separate AIDs, use of upstream active flags as study labels or selection by PHMT outcome. No activity rows or molecular aliases are inspected in this phase.

After complete receiving, list capacity survivors in descending SIDCountAll then AID ascending for future original-method/description review. No new detailed-source request is authorized by the count alone.
Class thresholds/endpoints, source rights, cohort selection and full method still require a separate declaration before dedicated activities/scores. This does not change #66 or add a release gate.
